column1: > Where every file in the package comes from. installer/validate.py and the
> release workflow read this and nothing else.
> repo    owner/name on github.com, or "-" for the repository being built
> ref     a full 40-hex commit, because a branch is not a pin
> UNRESOLVED is a source that has no published home yet. A payload row naming it
> must be gated by a preprocessor variable in abstraction.wxs, and the workflow
> leaves it out of the package and says so in the job summary. It is not a
> placeholder to be filled in silently: somebody has to decide where that file
